crossRefs.note: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…
“Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, wallet, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

translations.web: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
translations.bsb: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
translations.kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
translations.asv: And why are ye anxious concerning raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
